motivation.design: HYBRID: frozen RF family for Known-class prediction; V1 neural typed-block representation + Mahalanobis geometry for novelty; Evidence question isolated from the weaker neural closed-set classifier

hybrid_system.HYBRID_CLASS: frozen RF family prediction for the observation state
hybrid_system.HYBRID_NOVELTY: neural Mahalanobis novelty score (V1 architecture; per-state class means + one tied pooled LedoitWolf covariance fitted on OSR_TRAIN_FIT Known embeddings; min Mahalanobis distance to any Known class mean; higher = more novel)
hybrid_system.rf_component: exact frozen stored outputs: D0 uses stored pred_P0_BASIC_DIRECT; D1 uses stored pred_P6_UTILITY_TYPED; offline state-s oracle uses the frozen models pickle (read-only inference) cross-verified against stored outputs before use; no RF retraining or tuning
hybrid_system.neural_component: identical V1 training semantics: 150,000-row TRAIN pool, V1 group-safe 90/10 FIT/EARLY_STOP split with V1 preregistered per-cell counts, frozen features/transforms, multi-state exposure, CE + 0.10*SupCon (linear head = TRAINING AUXILIARY ONLY), AdamW lr=3e-4 wd=1e-4, batch 1024, seed, max 20 epochs, patience-3 Known-only early stopping

frozen_populations.val_gate_eval: split_role==1 (evaluation; True Unknown exposed ONLY for final metrics)
frozen_populations.p6_router: frozen stored P6 actions/preds; never retrained
frozen_populations.true_unknown_exclusion: representation training, normalization, early stopping, geometry fitting, calibration, model selection

adequacy.HYBRID_OSR_ADEQUACY_PASS_iff: H1 AND H2 AND H3 AND H4
adequacy.h1_rf_reproduction: Known Macro-F1 from frozen stored P0/P6 predictions on VAL_GATE_EVAL Known must reproduce the frozen V1 result JSON per-cell values within tolerance; also exact per-row stored-output reproduction from frozen models (0 mismatches)
adequacy.h2_metric: neural Basic Unknown AUROC vs frozen RF Basic AUROC (stored P0 scores)
adequacy.h4_metric: pooled paired bootstrap mean (Mahalanobis AUROC - same-encoder Deep MSP AUROC)

arms: D0_BASIC (RF Basic pred + neural Basic Mahalanobis)
D1_P6_SELECTIVE (exact frozen P6; RF pred + neural Mahalanobis from the acquired state)
deployable.calibration: policy-conditioned, Known-only, 5% Known false-Unknown rate, tie semantics rejected = score >= threshold; True Unknown never calibrates
deployable.d2: pooled paired group/temporal-block bootstrap 95% CI upper bound of (FURK(D1)-FURK(D0)) < 0

recovery.definition: for frozen Recoverable Known and legal state s: RECOVERED(s) = RF_s prediction correct AND neural-Mahal(s) accepted (below Known-only 5%-FUR threshold fitted for state s on VAL_CALIB Known); best-legal = max over legal states (GT-guided oracle, analysis-only, NEVER deployed)
recovery.ci_requirement: pooled paired group/temporal-block bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of (best-legal rate - Basic accept-correct rate) > 0

specificity.true_unknown_stress: most Known-ward legal Evidence state = max over legal states of Known-ward gain (KNOWNNESS(Basic) - KNOWNNESS(s)); KNOWNNESS = min Mahalanobis distance
specificity.c1: pooled mean gap (RK best-legal gain - TU most-Known-ward gain) > 0 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
specificity.c3_ratio_bound: pooled mean TU gain <= 0.50 x pooled mean RK gain (when RK gain > 0)
specificity.pass_iff: c1 AND c2 AND c3 AND c4

decision.GO: adequacy PASS + recovery PASS + specificity PASS + deployable PASS
decision.GO_SIGNAL_EXISTS_ROUTER_LIMITED: adequacy + recovery + specificity PASS, deployable FAIL, material frozen-router headroom (frozen P6 Evidence Recovery Rate <= 0.85 in >= 2/3 rotations, from frozen V1 result JSONs)
decision.NO_GO_CURRENT_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT: adequacy PASS AND (recovery FAIL OR specificity FAIL) AND safeguards do not contradict
decision.METHOD_DEPENDENT_REVIEW: remaining combinations and every safeguard contradiction

conditional_no_go_safeguards.trigger: ONLY if a valid primary result would otherwise produce NO_GO
conditional_no_go_safeguards.A_RAW_CONCAT: raw normalized concat encoding, central seed 20260817, all three rotations (V1 recipe)
conditional_no_go_safeguards.B_EDL: fixed Dirichlet/evidential uncertainty confirmation (V1-frozen EDL recipe: identical trunk, Dirichlet head alpha = softplus(z)+1, Type-II ML loss + fixed KL lambda=0.1, AdamW 3e-4/1e-4, 20 epochs, patience 3, Known-only; belief score 1 - max(alpha/S)), central seed 20260817, all three rotations
conditional_no_go_safeguards.scope: re-evaluate ONLY the recovery/specificity offline analyses
conditional_no_go_safeguards.contradiction_rule: materially contradictory strong positive (safeguard's own PASS criteria met on the failed criterion) -> METHOD_DEPENDENT_REVIEW instead of NO-GO

claim_boundary.scope: determines whether the CURRENT strict-past T/R Evidence contract has sufficient open-world recoverability value under a strong-hybrid OSR to justify expensive Model-B development
claim_boundary.no_go_meaning: a project research decision, not a proof that no model could use Evidence

execution_lock.after_first_formal_metric: only pure implementation bugfixes with unchanged scientific semantics, logged; scientific change -> STOP_NEEDS_REVIEW

git_policy.after_evaluation: DO NOT COMMIT result reports; DO NOT PUSH; leave for researcher review
